qualifier: exosome-mediated surveillance of noncoding RNAs (rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA, CUTs)
name: Nuclear exosome RNA surveillance and 3'-end trimming
rationale: All members are nuclear 3'-5' exonucleolytic decay or 3'-end trimming of rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA, CUTs and mRNA, unlike the confusables, which centre on endonucleolytic pre-rRNA processing and ribosome assembly or on cytoplasmic mRNA and tRNA decay.

qualifier: eosinophil and mast cell differentiation and activation
name: Th2-driven eosinophil and mast cell differentiation and activation
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, IL-5 production and eosinophil/mast cell differentiation, migration and activation, whereas the confusables have the IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 signalling and the negative cytokine regulation that this theme lacks.

qualifier: positive TAK1/IKK signalling downstream of TLR, NOD and noncanonical NIK receptors
name: Innate receptor-driven TAK1/IKK activation of NF-kB and JNK/p38
rationale: Members are the TLR/TRIF/IRAK, NOD1/2 and NIK routes through TAK1 and IKK to canonical and noncanonical NF-kB, JNK and p38. The confusables add TBK1-IRF3, TNFR1 and the negative and linear-ubiquitin regulators instead.

qualifier: with cholesterol and isoprenoid biosynthesis and peroxisome biogenesis
name: Peroxisomal lipid metabolism with cholesterol and isoprenoid biosynthesis
rationale: Members span peroxisome protein import and fission, peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation, ether lipid and VLCFA synthesis, and mevalonate-to-cholesterol synthesis, unlike the mitochondrial beta-oxidation/ketone confusables and the bile acid confusable.

qualifier: retinoic acid synthesis, CYP26 degradation and cellular response
name: Vitamin A to retinoic acid metabolism and response
rationale: All members concern retinol/retinal/retinoic acid metabolism (including CYP26 defects) and responses to vitamin A and retinoic acid, as opposed to the visual retinoid cycle and the vitamin D/K confusables.

qualifier: monocyte and dendritic cell signature, endogenous ligands
name: Monocyte and dendritic cell TLR inflammatory signalling
rationale: Members are monocyte/DC transcriptional modules plus inflammatory TLR signalling including endogenous ligands and heme, whereas the confusables centre on neutrophil degranulation/SIRP or on bacterial LPS/lipopeptide detection.

core: Renal fluid and blood pressure regulation
qualifier: by vasopressin and renin-angiotensin
name: Vasopressin and renin-angiotensin regulation of renal fluid balance
rationale: Members are vasopressin, angiotensin and aldosterone control of renal water and sodium handling, blood volume and arterial pressure. The confusables instead emphasise aquaporin/osmotic stress or natriuretic cGMP signalling.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9
name: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 common gamma-chain cytokine signalling
rationale: All members are IL-2, IL-7 or IL-9 signalling (with IL-2-STAT5), as distinct from the IL-15/IL-21, IL-3/IL-5 beta-common and FLT3 confusables.

qualifier: maintenance and apoptotic dismantling
name: Epithelial cell-cell junction maintenance and apoptotic dismantling
rationale: Members are generic epithelial cell-cell adhesion and apical/adherens junction sets plus junction maintenance and apoptotic cleavage of adhesion proteins, unlike the confusables' CDH1 trafficking, apical-basal polarity or cardiac desmosomes.

qualifier: endosomal trafficking and internalization of glutamate receptors
name: Endosomal glutamate receptor trafficking in postsynaptic plasticity
rationale: Members concern endosomal recycling and internalization of postsynaptic (AMPA) receptors, LTD, synaptic plasticity and short-term memory. The confusables instead cover presynaptic active zone, receptor clustering or BDNF signalling.

qualifier: medium-chain acyl-CoA and NAD(P) cofactor handling rather than oxidation
name: Peroxisomal medium-chain acyl-CoA and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members are medium-chain, malonyl- and succinyl-CoA metabolism, NADP+ synthesis, NAD transport and TYSND1 peroxisomal processing, without the alpha/beta-oxidation pathways that define the confusables.

qualifier: regulation of miRNA processing alongside fibroblast fate
name: Fibroblast fibrotic repair and miRNA biogenesis regulation
rationale: Members combine regulation of fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation, survival and connective tissue replacement with miRNA transcription and processing control. The miRNA arm is what the ECM, collagen and TGF-beta confusables lack.

qualifier: megakaryocyte/platelet and myeloid progenitor, RUNX1-regulated
name: RUNX1-regulated megakaryocyte and myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members cover RUNX1 transcriptional control, megakaryocyte/platelet development and myeloid progenitor/promyelocyte programmes, unlike the erythroid and monocyte/macrophage confusables.

qualifier: nucleoside triphosphate phosphate-bond hydrolysis
name: Nucleoside triphosphate catabolism by phosphate-bond hydrolysis
rationale: All members are catabolism of (purine/ribo)nucleoside triphosphates, including NUDT phosphohydrolysis. The confusables concern deoxynucleoside/monophosphate catabolism, purine salvage or nucleoside transport.

qualifier: glucose-sensing ChREBP and glucagon-PKA/AMPK/PP2A phosphorylation
name: Glucose-responsive ChREBP and glucagon-PKA metabolic control
rationale: Members are glucose-regulated (ChREBP) transcription and glucagon-PKA, AMPK and PP2A phosphorylation control of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride metabolism, unlike the LXR, SREBP and PPARA nuclear-receptor confusables.

qualifier: mesenchyme proliferation in lung and limb bud
name: Lung and limb bud mesenchyme proliferation via epithelial crosstalk
rationale: Members are reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling and mesenchymal cell proliferation in lung and limb bud, whereas the confusables concern epithelial branching in prostate, salivary gland and pancreas.

qualifier: epithelial lineages, ductal branching and lactation
name: Mammary gland epithelial development, branching and lactation
rationale: All members concern mammary epithelial lineages, duct and alveolar branching, thelarche and lactation, unlike the involution, prostate/reproductive tract and placental confusables.

qualifier: acyl-CoA oxidase route for very-long-chain and branched fatty acids
name: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long-chain and branched fatty acids
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation of VLCFA and pristanoyl-CoA (with ABCD1/ALD) down to medium chains, whereas the confusables cover alpha-oxidation, VLCFA/ether lipid synthesis or peroxisomal cofactor metabolism.

qualifier: de novo PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin synthesis
name: De novo PC, PE, PS and cardiolipin synthesis and turnover
rationale: Members are head-group synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin, plus cardiolipin/PG remodelling and lysophospholipid hydrolysis, unlike the confusables' Lands-cycle acyl remodelling and PI synthesis/transfer.

qualifier: PLK1 and Aurora A-driven mitotic entry
name: PLK1/Aurora A-driven mitotic entry and spindle checkpoint
rationale: Members cover PLK1, Aurora A and NEK kinase control of mitotic entry, spindle formation and spindle checkpoint signalling, whereas the confusables cover centrosome protein recruitment, cytokinesis or sister chromatid cohesion.

core: Death receptor apoptosis in T cells
qualifier: Fas/FasL-mediated activation-induced cell death
name: Fas ligand-mediated activation-induced T cell death
rationale: Members are FasL/CD95 signalling, BID activation, thymocyte apoptosis, T cell activation-induced death and T cell/allograft modules, unlike the TRAIL and generic extrinsic apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: miRNA biogenesis, RISC loading and target-directed miRNA decay
name: miRNA biogenesis, RISC loading and target-directed miRNA decay
rationale: Members span miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly, mRNA-destabilising silencing and miRNA turnover, whereas the confusables add deadenylation/P-body control, siRNA biogenesis or translational repression.

qualifier: glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids and analgesic/anti-inflammatory drugs
name: Glycine/glutamine conjugation and analgesic/anti-inflammatory drug metabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, CYP2E1 reactions and aspirin, paracetamol and prednisone ADME, unlike the acetylation/methylation, statin/antibiotic and mitochondrial confusables.

qualifier: ponatinib, lestaurtinib and tamatinib
name: FLT3 mutant resistance to ponatinib, lestaurtinib and tamatinib
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutants resistant to these three inhibitors. The confusables cover KIT mutant resistance, FLT3 resistance to other inhibitors, or FLT3 signalling.

qualifier: non-canonical caspase-4/5 and AIM2/NLRC4 (IPAF) inflammasomes
name: Pyroptosis via caspase-4/5, AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes
rationale: Members are pyroptotic cell death via CASP4/5, AIM2 and IPAF inflammasomes, whereas the confusables centre on NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes, IL-1/IL-18 processing and signalling.
